dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal midline. Three prominent rings exhibit a high-contrast, light-gray perimeter with irregular, jagged outer edges and a dark, low-intensity interior core. The gradient transition from the light perimeter to the dark interior is sharp, approximately 3-5 pixels in width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid-tone, high-intensity pixel clusters located in the neck region and along the lower lateral flank. These clusters lack an internal gradient or ring structure and appear as scattered, asymmetrical points of light contrast.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. The geometric relationship is defined by two primary rings aligned along the dorsal ridge with two secondary rings positioned ventrally on the mid-lateral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized, high-intensity white patch is visible on the distal tip of the posterior flipper, creating a high-contrast boundary against both the animal's dark pelt and the black background.
